primary_estimand.within_species_model: rank-standardized endpoint-safe post-IBD turnover ~ 1 + z(R_host_LGM) + z(R_host_present)
primary_estimand.primary_statistic: equal-weight mean beta_LGM_i across confirmatory species

synthetic_worlds.geometry: exact confirmatory survivor graph geometry and exact frozen present/LGM host predictors
synthetic_worlds.endpoint_dependence: simulate at locality level and derive edge turnover so edges sharing a locality remain dependent
synthetic_worlds.ibd: apply the identical endpoint-safe leave-two-localities-out rank-IBD response construction used by the later empirical analysis
synthetic_worlds.private_mean_structure: lineage-private spatial structure with no shared historical-host effect
synthetic_worlds.null_species_slope: mean zero; no positive host-history effect

positive_control.present_host_term: included under the frozen realized predictor covariance rather than removed from the design
positive_control.interpretation: a modest standardized historical-host effect that must be detectable after present-host control

qualification_gates.private_type1: For every private amplitude, Wilson 95% upper bound of rejection rate across 500 evaluation worlds <=0.10.
qualification_gates.positive_power: Wilson 95% lower bound of rejection rate across 500 positive worlds >=0.80.

empirical_decision_if_later_authorized.positive: observed mean_beta_LGM > 0 and least-favourable primary Monte Carlo p <=0.05

interpretation.positive: Past fragmentation of larval host resources left a detectable spatial genetic memory beyond the present host landscape in the qualified fresh narrow-host Lepidoptera domain.
interpretation.qualified_null: With adequate unique predictor information and calibrated power, the frozen 21-ka host-resistance predictor did not explain present post-IBD turnover beyond present host resistance.
